BiblicalUsage: Shealtiel means I have asked of God, and he is remembered as the father of Zerubbabel. When the exiles returned, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel rose up with Jeshua and began to build the house of God at Jerusalem. The father is named so the son can be placed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps His promises through ordinary lines of descent. Shealtiel asked, Zerubbabel built, and the house of God rose again on the faithfulness of one generation to the next.
